title: Optimize LIKE percent-only patterns
constraints: Preserve LIKE and ILIKE wildcard semantics
rationale: LIKE patterns that only use percent wildcards do not need the generic character-vector backtracking matcher. They can be evaluated with starts_with, find/contains, and suffix checks directly on string slices.
steps: Route patterns without '_' or '?' to a percent-only matcher
Support exact, prefix, suffix, contains, and multi-segment percent patterns without Vec<char> allocation
Keep complex wildcard patterns on the existing generic matcher
Add focused unit tests and run SQL LIKE/ILIKE regressions
expected_impact: Avoids text and pattern Vec<char> allocation for common LIKE patterns such as 'x%', '%x', and '%x%'.
